# Instructions for coding agents

<!-- Generated by ai/skills/agents-md.sh from the skills' frontmatter; do not edit. -->

This repository is a fork of the Idris 2 compiler, far ahead of upstream Idris 2 0.8:
the default back end compiles to C, errors carry codes, and there are libraries that
upstream does not have. What you remember about Idris 2, Idris 1 or Haskell is often
wrong here.

Before you write or change Idris code, read the skill that matches the task. A skill is
a `SKILL.md` with instructions, next to `references/` that it tells you when to read.
Every Idris example in the skills is type-checked by `ai/skills/check.sh`.

## Skills

- **idris2** (`ai/skills/idris2/SKILL.md`): Use for any Idris 2 work - writing, fixing, reviewing, explaining or porting `.idr` and `.ipkg` code, reading compiler errors (codes like E0201), filling holes, running the compiler or REPL, building executables and packages. Load it before writing the first line of Idris, even a short function - Idris 2 is not Haskell and not Idris 1, and this compiler differs from upstream Idris 2 (C back end by default, error codes with `--explain`, stricter totality, new libraries).
- **idris2-compiler-dev** (`ai/skills/idris2-compiler-dev/SKILL.md`): Use when working on the Idris 2 compiler itself in this repository: editing `src/`, `libs/` or `support/`, building or bootstrapping, adding or running golden tests (`make test only=`), error messages and codes, CHANGELOG_NEXT, lint, TTC versions, commit style. Load before any change to compiler sources, the libraries shipped with it, the C support code or `tests/`, and before benchmarking a compiler change, accepting changed `expected` files, or building in a tree that other agents share.
- **idris2-ffi** (`ai/skills/idris2-ffi/SKILL.md`): Use when Idris 2 code calls C or other foreign code - `%foreign`, binding or wrapping a C library (sqlite, curl, SDL, zlib, OpenSSL...), calling a libc function, linking a `.so`/`.a` or a glue `.c` file with RefC (`%cg refc refc-lib=`, `refc-pkg-config=`, `IDRIS2_CFLAGS`/`IDRIS2_LDLIBS`), `Ptr`/`AnyPtr`, `Struct`, `Buffer`, callbacks, `PrimIO`/`primIO`, finalisers (`onCollect`), who frees a string, JavaScript `%foreign "node:lambda:..."`, or a segfault or C compiler error at the FFI boundary.
- **idris2-libraries** (`ai/skills/idris2-libraries/SKILL.md`): Use when Idris 2 code needs libraries beyond the Prelude: HTTP servers/clients, routing, WebSocket, TLS/HTTPS, JSON encode/decode/derive, ByteString, HashMap/SortedMap, immutable arrays (`Data.Array`), files/directories/sockets/async IO, threads and channels, mutexes, atomic IORef, `catchCrash`, StateT/ReaderT/Control.App, string and number parsing, parser combinators, pretty printing, command-line parsing (GetOpt), deriving Eq/Ord/DecEq/Show/Functor (`Deriving.Eq`, `Deriving.Ord`, `Deriving.Show`). Gives the exact module, package and `-p` flags (they are not transitive), complete runnable examples, and how to discover an installed library's API with `:browse`/`:doc`/`:search`.
- **idris2-performance** (`ai/skills/idris2-performance/SKILL.md`): Use when an Idris 2 program is slow, uses too much memory, or type-checks/compiles slowly: profiling RefC executables, Int vs Integer vs Nat, strings, arrays, `%inline`/`%spec`, tail calls, W0007, IORef cost, long do-blocks, `--timing-summary`. Also use before optimising hot loops. Covers perf, IDRIS2_REFC_MEMSTATS/LEAKCHECK, strIndex and ++ in loops, fastConcat, IOArray vs flat arrays vs Buffer vs Data.Array, List/Vect indexing, `--spec-interfaces`, stack overflow, Lazy not memoised, fork doing work in the parent, `--jobs`, slow C builds; use it instead of GHC habits (laziness, strictness, fusion, -O2).
- **idris2-proofs** (`ai/skills/idris2-proofs/SKILL.md`): Use when an Idris 2 task involves proofs or dependent types: equality (`Refl`, `rewrite`, `cong`, `sym`, `replace`), proving lemmas about Nat, List or Vect, index arithmetic in `Vect (n + m)`, `Dec`/`decEq`/`DecEq`, deriving Eq/Ord/DecEq, `solveNat`, `Uninhabited`/`impossible`/`Void`, `with` and views, well-founded recursion; totality and termination errors ('not total', 'not covering', 'possibly not terminating', 'not strictly positive', E0601-E0704), including `total` code that uses `div`/`mod`; erased or linear quantities (`0`/`1`, 'is not accessible in this context', 'Can't match on ... (Erased argument)', linear name errors, E0606/E0801/E0802, `-@`, `LIO`). Also use for 'make this function total' and 'Can't solve constraint between' in a proof.

## In this repository

- Changing the compiler, the libraries under `libs/`, the C support code or the tests:
  read `ai/skills/idris2-compiler-dev/SKILL.md` first.
- Changing a skill: follow the rules in `ai/README.md`, then run `ai/skills/check.sh`.
